[7:23PM] #Ijanikin #TrafficUpdate 

Good vehicular movement from Abule Ado, but slow movement approaching the underbridge due to evening rush hour.
Smooth traffic flow from underbridge to Iyana Iba.
Busy traffic conditions on the main carriageway from Pako to Afolabi Ege.
Good movement from Iyana Iba intersection to Igando through LASU Gate, but slow movement approaching Red Gate to Estate Gate due to ongoing construction work.
Free-flowing traffic from First Gate to Obadore Bridge, with a smooth return journey to Iyana Iba.
Smooth movement along Badagry Expressway through Igbo Elerin Junction and Iyana Isashi, but moderate traffic approaching Iyana Era due to evening rush hour and pedestrian activity.
Good traffic flow from Iyana Era to Custom Checkpoint, with smooth movement in and out of Igbo Elerin.
Uncongested traffic on Afolabi Ege Flyover link to LASU-Isheri.

#FollowLASTMA
